name: original_bill
note: The SOL bill-payment prototype - 8 task screens, aligned to the Flutter dummy app A1 bill path (senior-ui-dummy-app 00834ca). Scope B: the bank menu tab plus card > 대표 생활요금; the other tabs are names only (docs/original-bill-scope.md). The steps go through the menu search because the coverage rule needs every screen walked and there are no error paths; the direct menu route (메뉴 > 은행 > 세금/공과금 > 납부하기) is walked in tests/test_original_bill.py. The dummy app has no error popup on this path - the password is not checked - so error_paths is empty and there are no *_WRONG values. truth: BANK/ACCOUNT are the withdrawal account, NAME the customer name on the bill, ENO the electronic payment number, QUERY the search word typed.
